name: TogglyAssociateBuild
description: Associate the current Azure DevOps build with a Toggly release
helpMarkDown: Associates the current build with a Toggly release. Can create a new release or find an existing draft release. [Learn more](https://docs.toggly.io/integrations/azure-devops)
author: Toggly

inputs.label: Project Key / Application ID

inputs.name: mode
inputs.label: Release Mode

options.use-latest-draft-or-create: Use latest draft or create new
